Precision CNC turning stainless steel components is usually used when components have to be durable, stable and have an immaculate finish, for example, in medical engineering technology, mechanical equipment, automobile , industrial equipment, automation equipment, household appliances and toy, etc. Get a Quote for Custom Stainless Steel Turning Solutions Why Stainless Steel for CNC Turning? Stainless steel is a popular material in CNC turning due to its excellent combination of mechanical strength, corrosion resistance, and aesthetic appearance. It is commonly used in demanding applications that require durability, such as medical instruments, automotive parts, food processing equipment, and marine hardware. Advantages of stainless steel for CNC turning include: Corrosion Resistance: Stainless steel forms a passive layer that protects against rust and oxidation, even in harsh environments. High Strength: Maintains integrity under mechanical stress, making it suitable for load-bearing parts. Temperature Resistance: Performs reliably at both high and low temperatures. Hygienic Properties: Easy to clean and sterilize, ideal for medical and food-related uses. Stainless Steel Materials & Grades for CNC Turning 304 Stainless Steel: The most widely used grade; offers excellent corrosion resistance and machinability. 316 Stainless Steel: Enhanced resistance to chemicals and saltwater, often used in marine and medical applications. 410/420 Stainless Steel: Higher hardness and wear resistance, suitable for shafts, valves, and tooling.
